components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Joined square ink-bordered strip; the selected cell is filled ink. Used for every view parameter (condition, metric, model, OS profile).
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 0 1px 1px 0; } .ds-seg button { font-family: 'B612', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #0e1013); border-radius: 0; margin: 0 -1px -1px 0; background: var(--paper, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0e1013); padding: 0 13px; min-height: 36px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color .15s, color .15s; } .ds-seg button:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #f0f1f3); } .ds-seg button:active { background: var(--axis, #b4bac2); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink, #0e1013); color: var(--paper, #fff); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { position: relative; z-index: 1; outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1f5fd0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.description: Single square ink-bordered cell that inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-lang { font-family: 'B612', system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 48px; min-height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink, #0e1013); background: var(--paper, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #0e1013); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s, color .15s; } .ds-lang:hover { background: var(--ink, #0e1013); color: var(--paper, #fff); } .ds-lang:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1f5fd0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Measured / Estimate Stamps
components.description: Says what kind of number a figure or page holds: green for measured, amber for simulator estimates, neutral for illustrations.
components.html: Measured Estimates Concept illustration
components.css: .ds-tag { font-family: 'B612', system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 2px; line-height: 1.45; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(14,16,19,.34)); color: var(--ink-2, #3a3f47); } .ds-tag svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; } .ds-tag-meas { background: var(--meas-bg, #e9f5ec); border-color: var(--meas-border, #8cc29b); color: var(--good-ink, #0b6b2a); } .ds-tag-est { background: var(--est-bg, #fbf3e2); border-color: var(--est-border, #d9b76a); color: var(--est, #7d5200); }

components.name: Time-Axis Navigation
components.description: The nav is a 2 px ink axis with one tick per view and a filled down arrowhead on the current view.
components.html: OverviewBaselineSchedulingMechanismEvidence
components.css: .ds-nav { font-family: 'B612', system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #0e1013); } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 13px 22px 11px 10px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink-3, #575d67); font-size: 14px; white-space: nowrap; transition: color .15s; } .ds-nav a::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 2px; height: 13px; background: var(--ink, #0e1013); transform: scaleY(0.54); transform-origin: top; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink, #0e1013); } .ds-nav a:hover::before { transform: none; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink, #0e1013); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]::before { left: -5px; width: 12px; height: 9px; transform: none; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 50% 100%); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1f5fd0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ruled Figure
components.description: A figure is ruled off above by a 2 px ink line, never boxed: title, subtitle, stamp at right, chart below.
components.css: .ds-fig { font-family: 'B612', system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #0e1013); padding-top: 16px; color: var(--ink, #0e1013); } .ds-fig-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-fig h3 { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-fig p { color: var(--ink-3, #575d67); font-size: 14px; margin: 0; } .ds-fig-stamp { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--meas-bg, #e9f5ec); border: 1px solid var(--meas-border, #8cc29b); color: var(--good-ink, #0b6b2a); } .ds-fig-body { height: 80px; background-image: linear-gradient(var(--grid, #e6e8eb) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 100% 20px; }

components.css: .ds-spec { font-family: 'B612', system-ui, sans-serif; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 0 40px; margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink, #0e1013); color: var(--ink, #0e1013); } .ds-spec > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; grid-template-areas: "t v" "d d"; column-gap: 16px; align-items: baseline; padding: 9px 0 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(14,16,19,.14)); } .ds-spec dt { grid-area: t; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-spec dd { margin: 0; } .ds-spec .v { grid-area: v; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; } .ds-spec .v span { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink-2, #3a3f47); margin-left: 4px; } .ds-spec .d { grid-area: d; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-3, #575d67); }

components.name: Timing-Diagram Lane
components.description: Signature notation: release arrow, open wait bar, solid service block, red hatched overrun, dashed deadline with a down arrowhead.
components.css: .ds-lane { position: relative; display: flex; height: 22px; margin: 24px 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--axis, #b4bac2); } .ds-rel { position: absolute; left: -1px; bottom: 0; height: 34px; border-left: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #0e1013); } .ds-rel::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -5.25px; top: -1px; width: 9px; height: 8px; background: var(--ink, #0e1013); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-wait { border: 1.5px solid var(--ink-2, #3a3f47); border-bottom: 0; } .ds-svc { background: var(--ink, #0e1013); } .ds-over { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--critical, #d03b3b) 0 2px, transparent 2px 6px); border: 1.5px solid var(--critical, #d03b3b); border-left: 0; border-bottom: 0; } .ds-dl { position: absolute; top: -14px; bottom: -6px; border-left: 1.5px dashed var(--ref, #0e1013); } .ds-dl::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -5.25px; top: -8px; width: 9px; height: 8px; background: var(--ref, #0e1013); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 50% 100%); } .ds-lane:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #0e1013) 7%, transparent); }

components.css: .ds-callout { font-family: 'B612', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--est-border, #d9b76a); background: var(--est-bg, #fbf3e2); color: var(--ink, #0e1013); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-callout p { margin: 0; max-width: 96ch; }

narrative.overview:
The whole site is drawn in real-time-scheduling notation: a millisecond axis, release arrows at t = 0, execution blocks, hatched overruns and a dashed deadline with a down arrowhead. The result the project exists to show, a regime boundary, reads as a figure rather than as a stat. The page is a white drafting ground carrying black ink; figures sit on the page between heavy ink rules instead of inside cards, and the one lead figure is an inverted ink plate (white line art on black) that runs edge to edge.

Density is that of a technical paper set for the screen: one family (B612, the cockpit-display face) at a short, deliberate ramp, tabular numerals for every number, square corners everywhere except a 2 px hair on small stamps. Colour is owned, not decorative: three hues belong to three scheduling policies, red belongs to time past the deadline, green and amber are the two stamps that say what kind of number you are looking at. Everything else is ink and grey. The world rejects the analytics-dashboard arrangement of grey page, white cards, stat tiles and pill tabs.

Navigation is itself a time axis (ticks per view, a filled arrowhead on the current one) and controls are joined ink-bordered strips with the selected cell filled. Motion is a single event: a playhead draws the lead diagram once on first load; everything else changes state without choreography.
keyCharacteristics: White drafting ground, black ink, square-cornered line art.
Heavy 2 px ink rules divide figures and sections; no cards, no boxes around charts.
One inverted ink plate per page at most, for the lead figure, redefining the same tokens locally.
Colour ownership: policy hues, late red, measured green, estimate amber; nothing else is coloured.
One type family (B612 + B612 Mono), bold for hierarchy, tabular numerals for data.
Notation is consistent everywhere: open bar = waiting, solid = measured service, hatch = past deadline or estimated, dashed arrow line = the deadline.

rules.name: The Colour Ownership Rule
rules.body: Latest blue, Guard orange and Adaptive teal belong to those three policies only; FIFO and legacy arms are grey. Never use a policy hue for decoration, a heading, a link or a UI state.

rules.name: The Late Is Red Rule
rules.body: Red means "past the deadline" (or a failed check) and nothing else, always as hatch plus outline so it survives without colour vision.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Measured numbers carry the green stamp; simulator estimates carry amber, in stamps, callouts and every estimate series. The two never share a figure or a colour.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: B612 for everything, B612 Mono for code and hashes. No second display face, no system display stack standing in for it.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number on a chart, table, spec list or tooltip uses tabular numerals so columns of values align.

rules.name: The Ruled Not Boxed Rule
rules.body: A figure is ruled off above with a 2 px ink line and never placed inside a card, panel or shadowed box. The only filled boxes are the estimate callout and stamps.

dos: **Do** separate figures and sections with a 2 px ink rule and let them sit on the white ground.
**Do** draw the deadline as a 1.5 px dashed line (4 3) with a down arrowhead, the same mark in every chart.
**Do** draw past-the-deadline time as a 45° red hatch with a solid red outline; estimated service in the concept figure as an ink hatch.
**Do** reserve latest-blue, guard-orange and adaptive-teal for their three policies and grey (arm-grey-4..6) for FIFO and legacy arms.
**Do** stamp every measured figure green and every simulator figure amber.
**Do** use tabular numerals and halo chart labels with a 4 px stroke in the ground colour.
**Do** keep controls as joined, square, ink-bordered segments with the selected cell filled.
**Do** keep motion to the one-time playhead and short (.15–.2s) state transitions on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`; honour reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** put figures in cards, add a grey page behind white panels, or build stat tiles.
**Don't** round controls into pills or tabs; corners stay square (stamps and callouts at 2 px).
**Don't** use a policy hue, red or amber for decoration, emphasis or links.
**Don't** let a simulation estimate share a figure, stamp or colour with a measured result.
**Don't** add a second typeface, or substitute system display fonts for B612.
**Don't** add drop shadows outside the floating tooltip.
**Don't** use text glyphs as icons or arrowheads; draw them as SVG or clip-path shapes.
